mapper.insert: INSERT INTO supervision_alert ( school_id, offering_id, session_id, alert_type, dedup_key, scan_run_id, severity, title, description, metric_value, threshold_value, rectification_deadline ) VALUES ( #{draft.schoolId}, #{draft.offeringId}, #{draft.sessionId}, #{draft.alertType}, #{draft.dedupKey}, #{scanRunId}, #{draft.severity}, #{draft.title}, #{draft.description}, #{draft.metricValue}, #{draft.thresholdValue}, #{deadline} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE dedup_key = dedup_key

INSERT INTO supervision_alert_action ( school_id, alert_id, from_status, to_status, action_type, comment, actor_id, actor_role ) VALUES ( #{schoolId}, #{alertId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{actionType}, #{comment}, #{actorId}, #{actorRole} )

INSERT INTO supervision_alert_action ( school_id, alert_id, from_status, to_status, action_type, comment, actor_id, actor_role ) VALUES ( #{schoolId}, #{alertId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{actionType}, #{comment}, NULL, 'SYSTEM' )

INSERT INTO regulator_notification ( regulator_user_id, school_id, alert_id, notification_type, title, content ) SELECT scope.regulator_user_id, #{schoolId}, #{alertId}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{content} FROM regulator_school_scope scope JOIN sys_user regulator ON regulator.id = scope.regulator_user_id AND regulator.enabled = TRUE WHERE scope.school_id = #{schoolId} AND scope.is_active = TRUE ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = VALUES(title), content = VALUES(content), is_read = FALSE, read_at = NULL, created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
INSERT INTO supervision_scan_run ( id, trigger_source, status, started_at, operator_user_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{triggerSource}, 'RUNNING', #{startedAt}, #{operatorUserId} )

INSERT INTO supervision_scan_run ( id, trigger_source, status, started_at, finished_at, failure_summary, operator_user_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{triggerSource}, 'FAILED', #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{failureSummary}, #{operatorUserId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE supervision_scan_run SET status = 'SUCCESS', finished_at = #{finishedAt}, candidate_count = #{candidateCount}, created_count = #{createdCount}, failure_summary = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supervision_scan_run WHERE status = 'RUNNING'

SELECT ssr.id, ssr.trigger_source AS triggerSource, ssr.status, ssr.started_at AS startedAt, ssr.finished_at AS finishedAt, ssr.candidate_count AS candidateCount, ssr.created_count AS createdCount, ssr.failure_summary AS failureSummary, ssr.operator_user_id AS operatorUserId, u.display_name AS operatorName FROM supervision_scan_run ssr LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ssr.operator_user_id ORDER BY ssr.started_at DESC, ssr.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: sa.id, sa.school_id AS schoolId, s.school_code AS schoolCode, s.school_name AS schoolName, sa.offering_id AS offeringId, o.offering_code AS offeringCode, o.term_id AS termId, COALESCE(at.term_name, o.term) AS termName, c.course_name AS courseName, c.category, t.full_name AS teacherName, sa.session_id AS sessionId, ls.session_date AS sessionDate, ls.start_time AS sessionStartTime, ls.end_time AS sessionEndTime, sa.alert_type AS alertType, sa.severity, sa.status, sa.title, sa.description, sa.metric_value AS metricValue, sa.threshold_value AS thresholdValue, sa.rectification_deadline AS rectificationDeadline, sa.detected_at AS detectedAt, sa.closed_at AS closedAt, sa.updated_at AS updatedAt, CASE WHEN sa.status <> 'CLOSED' AND sa.rectification_deadline < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS overdue
mapper.update: UPDATE supervision_alert SET status = #{toStatus}, closed_at = CASE WHEN #{toStatus} = 'CLOSED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
